name: Cheng Mei Materials Technology Corporation
summary: Cheng Mei Materials Technology Corporation manufactures and sells optoelectronic material and components in Taiwan and Mainland China. It offers optical structure embossing adhesive and transparent adhesive for mini LEDs; optical adhesive and film application; polarizers for handheld devices, automotive and public displays, desktop LCD, and energy savings applications; and mobile device displays and desktop monitors. Cheng Mei Materials Technology Corporation was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
